1→prepare:
     2→  stage: prepare
     3→  tags:
     4→    - danuri
     5→  script:
     6→    - echo CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE=$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE
     7→    - echo CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA=$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA
     8→    - echo FORCE_BUILD_TARGET=$FORCE_BUILD_TARGET
     9→    - echo CI_COMMIT_BRANCH=$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH # Note. Always empty on Merge Request pipeline
    10→    - echo CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_NAME=$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_SOURCE_BRANCH_NAME
    11→    - echo CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME=$CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TARGET_BRANCH_NAME
    12→    - echo HARBOR_URL=$HARBOR_URL
    13→    - echo HARBOR_PROJECT=$HARBOR_PROJECT
    14→  rules:
    15→    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "merge_request_event"'
    16→    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web"'
    17→    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" && ($CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "main" || $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "develop")'
    18→    - when: never
    19→

1→# 이미지 태그 생성 전략
     2→# - main: 상대년도.월일-MR번호 (예: 1.0106.123)
     3→#   ㄴ 상대년도: 2026년=1, 2027년=2, ... (2025년 기준)
     4→# - 그 외: 커밋 해시 (예: 1.0106.123-dev / 1.0106.abc1234-dev)
     5→
     6→.set_image_tag:
     7→  before_script:
     8→    - |
     9→      # 상대년도.월일 형식 (2026년=1, 2027년=2, ...)
    10→      YEAR=$(date +%Y)
    11→      RELATIVE_YEAR=$((YEAR - 2025))
    12→      MMDD=$(date +%m%d)
    13→      DATE="${RELATIVE_YEAR}.${MMDD}"
    14→      
    15→      # Git commit message에서 MR 번호 추출 (GitLab merge commit 형식)
    16→      # 형식: "See merge request project/path!123"
    17→      echo "Debug: Git log message:"
    18→      git log -1 --pretty=%B
    19→      echo "---"
    20→      # grep -oE로 !숫자 패턴 찾고 sed로 ! 제거
    21→      MR_NUMBER=$(git log -1 --pretty=%B | grep -oE '![0-9]+' | sed 's/!//' || echo "")
    22→      echo "Extracted MR_NUMBER: '${MR_NUMBER}'"
    23→      
    24→      if [ -n "$MR_NUMBER" ]; then
    25→        export IMAGE_TAG="${DATE}.${MR_NUMBER}"
    26→        echo "✅ image tag: ${IMAGE_TAG}"
    27→      else
    28→        # MR 번호를 찾지 못한 경우 fallback
    29→        export IMAGE_TAG="${DATE}.${CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA}"
    30→        echo "⚠️  MR number not found, using: ${IMAGE_TAG}"
    31→      fi
    32→      
    33→      # main 브랜치 아닌경우 postfix -dev 추가
    34→      if [ "$CI_COMMIT_BRANCH" != "main" ] ; then
    35→        export IMAGE_TAG="${IMAGE_TAG}-dev"
    36→        echo "📦 Development image tag: ${IMAGE_TAG}-dev"
    37→      fi
    38→

     6→    # Web UI 수동 트리거
     7→    - if: '$CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "web" && $FORCE_BUILD_TARGET != "" && ($FORCE_BUILD_TARGET == "all" || $FORCE_BUILD_TARGET == $PROJECT_PATH)'
     8→    # 운영 브랜치

    10→    - when: never

    12→    - echo [$(date +"%F %T")] Package install
    13→    - apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl jq sudo
    14→    - echo [$(date +"%F %T")] Package install finish
    15→    - chmod +x gradlew

**Image Tag Strategy**:
- Format: `RELATIVE_YEAR.MMDD.MR_NUMBER` (e.g., `1.0206.123`)
